name: Monday Jamaica Pond Social Loop
description: The Monday recovery standard: north from Forest Hills on the SW Corridor, over to Jamaica Pond, then back by the pond path.

name: Franklin Park Saturday Loop

name: Saturday Long Run Sampler
description: A bigger Saturday tour linking the SW Corridor, Jamaica Pond, the Arboretum, and Centre Street for runners looking for extra distance.
